comment: Paths `yarn product-name:check` lets keep the product's old "-izer" spelling (ADR 0132, PRD #1172). Each entry names a tracked path — a directory ending in `/`, or one file — and a written reason; an entry without a reason is rejected. An entry may carry `frozenFrom`, a regular expression: the file is excused only from the first line that matches it downward, so text above that line must use the new spelling. An entry is stale — and fails — when it names no tracked file, when it excuses no occurrence, or when its `frozenFrom` matches no line. The list is an allowlist of paths, never of values.

allowlist.reason: Research Briefs are frozen at their date (ADR 0041). They quote paths, names and output as they stood when written.

Entries for releases cut before the aligned release name projects and scopes as they were then. Everything from the first released-version heading down is history; new entries go above it and use the new spelling.
